topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I saw my words out there, where I didn’t put them. The page, so stark and still, bore my thoughts, my struggles, laid bare without my say. Each sentence, each twist of phrase I’d labored over, now a public thing. I wanted to reach out, to reclaim those pieces of myself, but my hands stayed at my sides. I wondered how many eyes had seen, how many minds had judged. Part of me ached to join the conversation, to explain, to defend what was torn from my notebook and pinned up for all to see. But I stayed silent, watching the shadows of my words dance on the walls, growing and shrinking as the day passed.
